name: agent-fleet-cc
description: One marketplace for delegation plugins: codex, antigravity (agy), cc (Claude Code via profiles)

scripts.verify: npm run check-version && npm run sync-shared && git diff --exit-code -- plugins/cc/scripts/lib/shared plugins/codex/scripts/lib/shared plugins/antigravity/scripts/lib/shared plugins/grok/scripts/lib/shared && npm test && npm run build:codex
scripts.test: npm run test:structure && npm run test:shared && npm run test:cc && npm run test:antigravity && npm run test:codex && npm run test:grok && npm run test:imagine && npm run test:e2e
scripts.prebuild:codex: mkdir -p plugins/codex/.generated/app-server-types && codex app-server generate-ts --out plugins/codex/.generated/app-server-types
